lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Agents found 3 billion dollars inside a popcorn tin.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In 2012, a hacker tricked the dark web market Silk Road into sending him more than 50,000 bitcoins.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then he waited. For almost ten years.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In 2021, agents raided his home. They found an underground safe, and in a bathroom closet, a popcorn tin with a tiny computer hidden inside.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: On it: more than 50,000 bitcoins, worth 3.36 billion dollars.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The most expensive popcorn in history.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The full story is on Unfiled Films.
